headline: On a third family in a different ecosystem (urfave/cli, Go), a procedure card detected automatically (potion-8M prompt match, threshold chosen on other families) and delivered as UserPromptSubmit additionalContext cut $/task by 33.8% [23.6, 44.3] and calls by 31.5% vs control, pass rate unchanged (2/12 vs 2/12); detection had 0 false fires on 53 same-repo negatives and 58 real non-family sessions but recognised 0/6 informal paraphrases; a card from 1 session saved only 9.4% [-24.7, +8.2].
metric_name: live billed $ per session, card-by-hook/control - 1, paired by (variant, repeat), 90% bootstrap over 6 variants

detection.method: pre-registered: potion-base-8M, max cosine to the family's prior prompts in the same repo; tau from training families (click, marshmallow) = 0.811 (n4) / 0.753 (n1); grey zone tau-0.10 delivers on first edit of a card file

learning_curve: n=1 card -9.4% [-24.7, +8.2] vs n=4 -33.8%: the card needs >= 2 sessions when file names vary per task (anti-unification); stage 1's 'saturates after one session' holds only for families with fixed file names
leave_one_repo_out: the detection threshold was chosen on click+marshmallow and applied unchanged to urfave-cli (a held-out repository and ecosystem)
hard_coded_parts: stage-1 list (edit tool set, shell normalisation, need=ceil(n/2), clip lengths, card headings)
name tokenisation on _ . - and the (dir, token count, first token, extension) grouping for varying file names
shell-redirect parsing for files written by commands
tau selection rule (midpoint or max negative + 0.01) and the 0.10 grey margin
benchmark family, prompts, hidden Go test, gold patches, hard negatives and paraphrases (hand-written instruments)
ceiling: not re-measured for Go; stage 1 perfect-procedure oracle 73% of $
build_recommendation: Port procedure.py as `adage` workflow-family cards (spec in README.md): compile after >= 2 sessions of a family (anti-unified file patterns), deliver at UserPromptSubmit via the intent trigger at a conservative threshold (precision 1.0 here) plus the edited-card-file grey-zone signal; grow each family's prompt library from matched sessions so recall covers users' own phrasing; add outcome awareness (steps failing checks point to that no session took). Expected -16% to -34% $ on family-matching tasks; realised share depends on detection recall on real phrasing, unmeasured.
so_what: Card-by-hook with automatic detection: -33.8% $ [23.6, 44.3] and -31.5% calls on a Go family, pass rate unchanged, 0 false fires on 111 same-repo negative prompts/sessions (upper 90% bounds <= 4.9%); recall on paraphrased requests 0/6, so the shipped value is bounded by how often users' prompts resemble earlier ones; moderate-to-good confidence for the effect when fired, detection recall on real phrasing unproven.
prereg: prereg.json + prompts_extra.json (written before any score or session of this stage)
